theme_strategy.rationale: Health and wellness apps benefit from bright, clean, organic aesthetics to build trust and optimism. A dark mode toggle is available in Settings, leveraging deep obsidian and high-end glassmorphism for a premium 'clinical' night view.

headings.style: Rounded Humanist Sans for a friendly yet clinical tone. Tightly tracked (tracking-tight) for large sizes.

scales.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter leading-none font-bold

body.style: Clean geometric sans for maximum readability in data-heavy dashboard views.

rules: Inter is strictly BANNED for headings. Use Manrope.
Do not jump more than 2 Tailwind steps between headings and subheadings.
No full-screen gradients. Use subtle background blurs or solid colors.
Never use pure #000000 or #808080. Greys must be tinted.
BANNED COLOR: Teal green/blue (#1B93A4) for dashboards. BANNED COLOR for AI: #7351B7.
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.headers_nav: Glassmorphism (The 'Crystal' Variant). Light mode: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/40 shadow-sm. Never fully transparent.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.dashboard_cards: Flat background with 1px subtle border, rounded-2xl. Soft ambient shadow on hover (-translate-y-1 shadow-lg).
surfaces_and_micro_themes.photo_upload_zone: Neumorphism mix. Dashed 2px border, bg-stone-50, inside a rounded-3xl container with generous p-8 padding.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.ai_results_card: The 'Tracing Beam' look. A glowing border effect (using Framer Motion or mask-image) to signify AI analysis in progress, fading to a clean solid card once complete.

layouts_and_grids.marketing_pages: Mode A: 'Tetris' Grid. Asymmetrical grid-cols-12 with wide gap-8 to gap-12. Overlapping text and image sections with generous padding (p-16 to p-32).
layouts_and_grids.dashboard: Mode B: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. gap-6. Summary metrics take col-span-1, main charts take col-span-3.
layouts_and_grids.spacing_system: Generous spacing. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards to avoid text collision with borders.
layouts_and_grids.alignment: Left-align paragraphs, inputs, and dense content. Center only if it improves visual rhythm (like the landing page hero).

components.forms_and_inputs: Shadcn/UI heavily customized. Use soft radii (rounded-xl) and 1px borders. Never use native inputs.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or smooth rounded-xl. Explicit hover states (e.g., hover:bg-stone-800 hover:text-white).
components.charts: Shadcn chart components or Recharts. Focus on modularity: high-level number -> comparative annotation -> minimal chart.
components.photo_alignment_overlay: Use SVG paths overlaid on the camera feed/image preview with opacity-50 for silhouette guidance.
components.tabs: Shadcn tabs, but remove fixed height (h-9) -> use h-auto to prevent cutoff.

motion_and_interactions.transitions: Specific transitions only. NO 'transition: all'. Example: transition-transform duration-200 ease-out.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements need micro-animations (scale up/down, color shift).
motion_and_interactions.page_load: Framer Motion staggered entrances for dashboard grid items (delay by 0.05s per item).
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Add aria-hidden='true' to purely decorative SVG overlays.

hero_background.description: Abstract soft white gradient blur. Use as landing page background behind text.

healthy_hair_close_up.description: Close up of healthy brown wavy hair. Use as a background texture for AI coverage score or success state.

user_mirror_reflection.description: Man looking at himself in a mirror. Perfect for the 'Before/After' feature section on the landing page or timeline placeholder.

media_and_images.rules: Images must not exceed 80vh on mobile. Never use placeholder text for images. If you need avatars, use lucide-react User icon or solid color circles.

3d_libraries_and_charts.charts: Recharts (via Shadcn) for density/hairline trend cards and timeline progress charts.
3d_libraries_and_charts.animations: Framer Motion for image gallery drag-and-drop interactions and page transitions.
3d_libraries_and_charts.icons: lucide-react (default) for standard UI. If a medical/clinical feel is needed, you can use iconoir-react, but stick to lucide for speed.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the Landing Page with custom HTML/Tailwind, avoiding Shadcn generic cards to maintain a creative 'Apple' aesthetic.
For the Dashboard, timeline, and Results, use a combination of Shadcn and Custom raw CSS grids.
Implement the Photo Upload with a drag-and-drop zone, integrating a silhouette overlay SVG.
Ensure the Timeline milestones (Week 0, 2, 4, 8) act as stepper triggers that load comparison views.
Implement Google Login UI in the Auth section.
Include a 'Dark Mode' toggle in the Settings page.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. No generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, or uniform styling.
DO NOT apply 'transition: all'. Use specific transitions (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).
DO NOT center align the entire app container (.App { text-align: center; } is BANNED).
Use modern button styles (pill-shaped or rounded-xl) with interaction animations.
Do not use AI emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use lucide-react icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Use p-8 or p-12 for major containers.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
